duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā wajʿalnā muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatinā ummatam muslimatan laka wa arinā manāsikanā wa tub ʿalaynā innaka Antat-Tawwābur-Raḥīm.
duas.translation: Our Lord! make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi qad ātaytanī minal-mulki wa ʿallamtanī min ta'wīlil-aḥādīth. Fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ. Anta waliyyī fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Tawaffanī Muslimanw-wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
duas.translation: Thou Creator of the heavens and the earth! Thou art my Protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Take Thou my soul (at death) as one submitting to Thy will (as a Muslim), and unite me with the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awziʿnī an ashkura niʿmataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya wa ʿalā wālidayya wa an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī; innī tubtu ilayka wa innī minal-muslimīn.
duas.translation: O my Lord! Grant me that I may be grateful for Thy favour which Thou hast bestowed upon me, and upon both my parents, and that I may work righteousness such as Thou mayest approve, and be gracious to me in my issue. Truly have I turned to Thee and truly do I bow (to Thee) in Islam.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa ilayka anabnā wa ilaykal-maṣīr.
duas.translation: Our Lord! in Thee do we trust, and to Thee do we turn in repentance: to Thee is (our) Final Goal.

duas.arabic: إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Inna ṣalātī wa nusukī wa maḥyāyā wa mamātī lillāhi Rabbil-ʿālamīn. Lā sharīka lahū wa bi-dhālika umirtu wa ana awwalul-muslimīn.
duas.translation: Truly, my prayer and my service of sacrifice, my life and my death, are (all) for Allah, the Cherisher of the Worlds: No partner hath He. This am I commanded, and I am the first of those who bow to His will.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā Huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm, lā ta’khudhuhū sinatunw-wa lā nawm, lahū mā fissamāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ, man dhalladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum wa lā yuḥīṭūna bishay’im-min ʿilmihī illā bimā shā’, wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa lā ya’ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wa Huwal-ʿAliyyul-ʿAẓīm.
duas.translation: Allah! There is no god but He, the Living, the Self-subsisting, Eternal. No slumber can seize Him nor sleep. His are all things in the heavens and on earth. Who is there can intercede in His presence except as He permitteth? He knows what is before or after or behind them. Nor shall they encompass aught of His knowledge except as He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them, for He is the Most High, the Supreme (in glory).

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wattabaʿnar-Rasūla faktubnā maʿash-shāhidīn.
duas.translation: Our Lord! we believe in what Thou hast revealed, and we follow the Messenger, then write us down among those who bear witness.
For us Allah sufficeth, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-ʿArshil-ʿAẓīm.
duas.translation: Allah sufficeth me: there is no god but He: On Him is my trust, and He is the Lord of the Throne Supreme.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā Rabbinā lamunqalibūn.
duas.translation: Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves). And to our Lord, surely, must we return.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.translation: Our Lord! Accept (this service) from us: For Thou art the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
